in_marathi.name: Ganikarani
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of wealth and prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ganikarani हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ganikarani is a Sanskrit name derived from the words ‘Gana’ meaning ‘group’ or ‘community’, and ‘Karani’ meaning ‘doer’ or ‘provider’. This name is attributed to the Hindu goddess Lakshmi, who is revered as the deity of wealth, fortune, and prosperity. The name signifies a woman who is the giver, provider, and nurturer of wealth and blessings for her community.
